title: Distributed-Slides / A demonstration performance
footer: Demonstration deck generated by the Distributed-Slides smoke test. Synthetic data.

scenes.title: Slides that behave like instruments, not documents
scenes.subtitle:
Every animation is a pure function of the clock.
Scrub it, replay it, mirror it to the audience window.
scenes.notes: Open confidently. The point of this deck is that the animations are deterministic.

scenes.title: mount(stage, scene) returns update(t) — and everything else follows
scenes.body: Because motion derives from the presenter clock, pausing, scrubbing, playback speed and the synchronized audience window are exact, not approximate.
scenes.notes: This is the single engineering decision the rest of the system falls out of.
scenes.cue: The whole system rests on one contract.

scenes.title: Choreographed elements
scenes.notes: Boxes, text, connectors — each enters on its own schedule.

text.text: Any layout, any timing, one clock
Connectors draw themselves between elements; arrowheads and timing are automatic.

scenes.title: The diagram engine assembles a system in narrated stages
scenes.subtitle: Nodes carry tone-coded spines; edges auto-route, draw on, and carry traveling dots.
scenes.notes: Watch the stages land in the order you would narrate them.

phases.body: Derived records are readable by any process.

scenes.title: Bars grow and count in step with the clock
Series reveal progressively with a live readout

The lanes engine: six series in perspective, as a first-class type
scenes.notes: The HEAT price topography, extracted: this is data plus one scene spec, no code.
scenes.cue: The topography is now a built-in.
scenes.footnote: Synthetic replay. Gaps in the source remain gaps on screen.

scenes.title: The trajectory engine: temperature × price × time
scenes.notes: One minute is one point. The gold trail is the last 90 minutes.

notes: The same x value can appear at different y values.

scenes.title: The matrix engine: ten panels, one shared clock, local offsets
scenes.notes: Each panel keeps its own clock offset and bar geometry.

scenes.title: The cycle engine: a workflow loop with retained artifacts
scenes.notes: The active stage advances with the clock; the rail shows what must persist.
scenes.panelFooter: The model can change. This record persists.

scenes.title: Custom canvas: six quote lanes in perspective
scenes.notes: This scene is user code — the same class of scene as the HEAT price topography.
scenes.cue: And when the built-ins are not enough, you write the scene.

scenes.title: Custom SVG: the primitive kit with chrome for free
scenes.subtitle: box, flow, group, text, value — the same kit the built-in engines use.
scenes.notes: SVG custom scenes get the standard chrome and caption bar without writing them.
scenes.cue: The SVG variant hands you the whole kit.
scenes.footnote: Demonstration scene authored as a code string through the MCP.
